title: Zillertalbahn Dampfzug
highlights: Traditionsreiche Schmalspurbahn mit 760 mm Spurweite durch das gesamte Zillertal
Nostalgischer Dampfzug mit historischem Kristall-Waggon und offenem Aussichtswagen
32 Kilometer gemuetliche Fahrt von Jenbach ueber Fuegen und Zell nach Mayrhofen
Perfekte Kombination fuer Radfahrer mit kostenlosem Fahrradtransport im Zug
kurzbeschreibung: The historic steam train of the Zillertalbahn travels nostalgically across 32 kilometres from Jenbach through the Zillertal all the way to Mayrhofen.
beschreibung:
Railway Romance in the Zillertal

The Zillertalbahn is among the most famous narrow-gauge railways in the world. Since 1902, it has connected the Inntal with the upper Zillertal. Alongside modern regional train services, the legendary steam train with lovingly restored wooden carriages operates during the summer months.

Travelling as in Imperial Times

With whistles and hisses, the historic steam locomotive leisurely pulls its train along the river Ziller. A ride in the open-air convertible wagon or in the sparkling crystal wagon is a truly special experience, while the alpine panorama of the Zillertaler Alpen glides gently by.
